draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.91, the 170th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 23rd of 37 at CB. He went 137th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (170th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: three-cone (16th percentile). College production: 6 passes defended in 2020, 12th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Jets (reserve). 49 career games and 14 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile), passes defended 0 (8th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 4.6% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, below the norm.
